card.name: Inside hemorrhagic and attenuated
card.fires_on: The middle or end of two medical words: the 'agic' ending of hemorrhagic, and the 'attenu' start of attenuated or attenuate. It shows up in warnings about bleeding, cystitis, live vaccines and reduced drug effect.

modes.label: hemorrhagic
modes.description: The 'agic' ending after 'hemorrh' in phrases like hemorrhagic cystitis, events, fever or stroke.
